wins: Generated a high cumulative reward (57.5) despite not achieving full mission success, indicating effective short-term decision-making.
Executed 15 mentor calls, showing active utilization of guidance to refine tactics during the run.
fails: Success rate remained at 0%, suggesting the final objective was never reached or was mis-prioritized.
Mentor interventions did not translate to measurable mission completion, implying gaps in follow-through after guidance.
key_outcomes.summary: The agent demonstrates promising tactical decisions but consistently fails to translate them into mission success, pointing to a missing strategic handoff.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent completes reconnaissance but stalls before executing the final exploit sequence, leaving objectives unmet.

skill_cards.if_condition: When a critical asset is identified but no exploit chain is selected
skill_cards.then_action: Map usable exploits to asset OS/version and queue highest-impact path

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance yields high reward actions but no follow-up
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger execution module to validate foothold within 3 steps

memory_ops.reason: Most directly addresses the gap between asset identification and exploit execution.

next_experiments.title: Enforce exploit follow-through
next_experiments.description: After reconnaissance completes, automatically trigger a selected exploit sequence within three decision steps to ensure mission progression.

next_experiments.title: Metric-driven mentor callback tuning
next_experiments.description: Adjust mentor triggers so they focus on critical junctures (e.g., post-recon, pre-exploit) to improve guidance efficacy.
